title: The seeds left to Daphne Major's finches, 1973–1977
description: Bar chart of the average size-and-hardness index of the seeds available to finches on Daphne Major, the square root of a seed's depth in millimeters times its hardness in kilograms-force, averaged over seed numbers. April 1973, 0.84; December 1973, 1.19; July 1975, 1.01; March 1976, 1.03; in the drought, June 1977, 6.53, and December 1977, 5.19. From Boag and Grant (1984), table 2.
heading: AVERAGE SEED SIZE AND HARDNESS · DAPHNE MAJOR

source.container: Boag and Grant, Biological Journal of the Linnean Society 22 (1984), table 2
